name: Send your SMS campaign immediately
description: Send your SMS campaign immediately. Send an existing SMS campaign immediately by scheduling it for the current time. The system verifies your account''s SMS credit balance before dispatching; if credits are insufficient or the remaining credit is less than the number of recipients, a 402 error is returned. The campaign must have valid recipients and content already configured.
